c1.note: Legend Holdings is Lenovo's largest/controlling shareholder (32.04% at 31 Mar 2026) and describes Lenovo as its subsidiary; widely cited as parent.

c3.note: Legend holds 32.04%, far above any other holder listed, and consolidates Lenovo; Wikipedia calls it the controlling shareholder.

c7.note: Legend's Dec 2025 announcement states Lenovo will remain a subsidiary with continued consolidation.

c9.note: Lenovo's shareholding page shows Legend at 32.04% as of 31 Mar 2026.

c12.note: Legend holds about 32%, and 61% is held by others, so Lenovo is not wholly owned.

c13.note: The claim that Lenovo has no controlling parent contradicts Legend's status as controlling shareholder and its consolidation of Lenovo, though it is correct that no one holds a majority and that Lenovo is listed.

c14.note: The Dec 2025 announcement reports 32.34% after buying 115,174,000 shares; the stake was later reported lower at 32.04% as of Mar 2026.

c16.note: Lenovo's shareholding page and the annual report both show Yang Yuanqing at 6.15% as of 2026-03-31, behind Legend at 32.04%.

c17.note: 'Others' is shown as 61.05%, and that bucket excludes Legend, Yang and the other directors.

c18.note: Legend Holdings is Lenovo's controlling shareholder and is widely described as its parent. The 'listed parent N/A' item in the HKEX form does not show that there is no parent.

c19.note: Lenovo Group Limited is the listed holding company of its subsidiaries, which is consistent with the annual report, though no passage quotes the phrase. It is itself a subsidiary of Legend, which holds 32.04%.

c21.note: This matches the usual definition of 'Lenovo Group' in Lenovo's annual reports. The saved passages do not quote the definition directly.

c22.note: The note on Lenovo's shareholding page states the 12,404,659,302 share basis as at 2026-03-31.

c23.note: The annual report refers to the 'financial year ended March 31', and FY2025/26 ends on that date.

c24.note: Wikipedia describes Legend Holdings as a Chinese investment holding company with interests in finance, real estate and IT.

c25.note: Wikipedia says Legend was formed by the Chinese Academy of Sciences and is the controlling shareholder of Lenovo.

c26.note: HKEX Form 2 serial CS20250903E00427 names Legend as substantial shareholder of Lenovo (00992), with the event dated 29/08/2025.

c27.note: The notice shows Right Lane Limited at 100% controlled by Legend and holding shares through Legion Elite and Kind Jasper. Legend's own direct holding is not separately shown in the excerpts.

c28.note: Item 16 on Form 2 asks for the substantial shareholder's own listed parent. Legend has none, so 'N/A' says nothing about Lenovo's parent.

c29.note: Wikipedia's infobox gives the Chinese Academy of Sciences (via its holdings arm) 29.04% of Legend, which is stale-prone, and the 'ultimate owner' wording is interpretive.

c30.note: Lenovo's 17 June 2011 statement says Legend would hold 34.82% and remain the largest, sole controlling shareholder. It is historical context only.

c31.note: Legend holds about 32.34% and consolidates Lenovo as a subsidiary; the 'associate' wording is not supported by the passages, but the core claim is right.

c32.note: 34.82% in 2011 and 32.34% in Dec 2025 are confirmed; the Wikipedia and Simply Wall St figures are not checked but plausible.

c35.note: Legend Holdings (HKEX 3396) and Legend Capital are separate entities, and Legend Capital is a Legend-affiliated VC firm; this is a disambiguation note rather than an answer.

c5.note: Legend's 2026 interim document, dated Sept 2026, calls Lenovo Group Limited 'our subsidiary'. Lenovo's IR page lists Legend as its largest shareholder at 32.04% as of Mar 31, 2026.

c11.note: Legend's interim announcement for the six months to 30 June 2026 says it directly and indirectly held a 32.95% equity interest in Lenovo. A web search surfaced that text.
